G0003 - ((exp(i*theta)**(m + 1) - exp(i*theta)**(-(m + 1)))/(exp(i*theta) - exp(i*theta)**(-1))) = 0 after using exp(i*x) - exp(-i*x) = 2*i*sin(x)
hypotheses.rationale: The three catalog members are the same finite geometric sum expressed as expanded sum, closed quotient, and unit-circle specialization.
